Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Australian players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Devon Conway will open the innings for New Zealand. Ashton Agar will start the proceedings for Australia.

Kane Williamson will be happy with how things have panned out in the first innings. Their bowlers maintained control over the Aussies in most part of the innings and did not allow them to run away with the game. It was more about spin for the Kiwis as their spinner dominated proceedings. Sodhi was the pick of the lot, as he finished with figures of 4-0-24-3 and even though Santner went wicketless, he just gave away 21 runs in his quota of 4 overs. Boult too was very good as he gave away just 26 runs and also removed 2 batters. With just 143 needed to win, the Black Caps would be confident of chasing this down whereas the Aussies will be hoping for a better show with the ball. Join us shortly for an exciting run chase.

Trent Boult is in for a chat! He says that it is a decent total but the boys hung in there nicely and hopes that they can chase it down. Tells that Australia has some good players and they played some nice shots but they bowled well too. Says that it is nice to get a wicket. Opines that the total looks like something they can scale down and they will try to bat well.

A very good bowling effort from the Kiwis has seen them restrict their counterparts to a decent total, which they believe they will be able to chase down, with their batting firepower. The visitors lost Josh Philippe very early on, in the Powerplay. Finch and Wade slowly got things back on track when Finch holed out. Maxwell followed him shortly and the spinners of the Black Caps were doing well to not allow Australia to play their strokes freely. After Wade fell, none of the Australian batters could accelerate towards the end of the innings and they have ended up with a total of 142, to their name.

OUT! CAUGHT! Southee gets his second wicket! Full on middle, Jhye Richardson swings it over mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards the fielder where Glenn Phillips takes a comfortable catch. AUSTRALIA END WITH 142/8!
Length delivery on middle, Richardson pulls it through mid on for a single.
Full toss on middle, Jhye swings it towards long on for a run.
Low full toss on middle, Kane hits it towards long on for a single.
The other Richardson comes out now. Kane Richardson is in!

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Southee seemed to be missing the mark when he started the over, but he has found his mark here. He bowls a pacy yorker on middle, Marsh looks to play at this but he misses and the ball sneaks in under the bat. The ball does not miss though. You know the rest.
WIDE! Southee bowls it wide outside off, Marsh lets it go.
Length delivery on middle, Richardson looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.
NO BALL! High full toss on middle, Marsh pulls it through mid-wicket for a single. The umpire gives no ball for height. Free Hit coming up!
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, Marsh leaves it alone.
Low full toss on off, Marsh drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! That is powerful! Length delivery on middle, Marsh smashes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full delivery on middle, Marsh looks to flick but gets an inside edge. It goes to short fine leg.
Full toss on off, Jhye drives it through covers for a single.
Full on middle, Marsh flicks it through square leg for a run.
Length ball on off, Richardson guides it towards point for a single.
Full again on middle, Richardson flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. Sodhi finishes with figures of 4-0-24-3. Brilliant!
Full ball on off, Marsh drives it through covers for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Marsh pushes it to covers.
No hat-trick for Sodhi! Full delivery on off, Marsh keeps it out.
Who comes out now? Jhye Richardson, it is. Ish is on a hat-trick too!

OUT! CAUGHT! An action replay of the previous dismissal and Australia lose their 6th wicket. Sodhi doing really well to close out his spell for the day on a bang. He goes for the full toss outside off again, Agar skips down and looks to slam this one over the deep mid-wicket region but again, with no proper timing on this one. Holes out to Martin Guptill again in the deep.
Mitchell Marsh comes out now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Guptill gets another catch and Australia lose another. This was a freebie and it had to be dispatched but instead, he holes out. This one is outside off, Marcus Stoinis looks to muscle this one over the fielder at long off but does not quite time it well. An easy take for Martin Guptill in the deep. Ish gets his second of the game as well.
Yorker on middle, Stoinis digs it out towards long on for a single.
SIX! That is dispatched! Full on middle, Stoinis lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Ish Sodhi to bowl out. 3-0-22-1 so far.
Yorker on off, Agar plays it towards mid off for a single.

DROPPED! Conway is the culprit! Length delivery on middle, Stoinis lofts it over mid on but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards long on where Devon Conway tries to take the catch but spills it. The batsmen take a single.
Good length delivery on off, Stoinis guides it to short third man.
Full on off, Agar drives it through covers for a single.
Full on off, Agar drives it towards mid off for a single. 4-0-21-0 are his figures for the day. Very neat and tidy from Mitchell Santner with the ball.
Tim Southee is back into the attack. 0/21 from his 2 overs so far.
Short again and outside off, Stoinis pushes it towards covers for a run.
Short delivery on off, Agar cuts it through point for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Stoinis flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Floated delivery on middle, Agar pushes it through mid on for a single.
Full on off, Stoinis lofts it uppishly towards covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, Stoinis pushes it towards point for a quick single.
Length delivery on off, Stoinis pushes it to point.
Full ball on middle, Agar flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Stoinis pulls it towards short fine leg for a single.
Ashton Agar trudges out now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The decision to bring on Boult by Kane Williamson has paid rich dividends for the Kiwis. Wade was looking set so far and the Aussies would have wanted him to continue but he perishes. A slower full ball on middle, Wade looks to flick but does so uppishly towards the deep mid-wicket region, where Martin Guptill takes the catch, diving forward.
Length delivery on off, Stoinis pushes it towards mid off for a run.
On off, Stoinis drives it through mid off for a single. Very tidy from Santner. Only 3 off this one.
BEATEN! Loopy delivery outside off, Stoinis looks to cut but misses it.
Some pace is back on now. Trent Boult to speed in again. 2-0-12-1 so far.
Short ball on off, Wade punches it through covers for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Stoinis pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on off, Stoinis cuts it to short third man.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Stoinis works it to mid-wicket.
Full toss around off, Stoinis bunts this one to long on for a single.
WIDE. Another delivery which is outside the tramline. The umpire calls this as a wide.
Outside off, flighted, worked to the off side.
WIDE. Way too outside off this time. Left alone. Wide signalled.
Outside off, floated, Stoinis looks to push this one away but misses.
FOUR! A freebie and Marcus does not miss out. This one is outside off, Marcus Stoinis carves this one over point for a boundary.
WIDE. Way too outside off, left alone. Wided.

FOUR! Over the man in the deep. Tosses this one up and lands it just around off, Marcus Stoinis lofts this one with power towards the long on region where Devon Conway tries to scalp this but misses and the ball takes a bounce and crosses over.
Flatter outside off, bunted through mid off for a single.
Glenn Phillips is back on.
Worked to the deep cover region for a single again. 9 off Sodhi's third over.
Flatter outside off, Stoinis punches this one through cover-point for a single.
Floated on middle, pushed to the off side.
Turn and bounce for Sodhi. Fuller, around off, it hits the deck and turns away and also takes off as Marcus prods ahead, looking to block. Misses and the ball goes to the keeper's mitts.
Around off, short, punched to covers for a quick run.
SIX! Wade wants to charge now. Tossed up and around off on this occasion, Wade gets low and mows a slog sweep over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Full on off, Stoinis pushes it back towards the bowler.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one falls for Australia and the Black Caps are doing really well to come back into this game. Maxwell goes back for a measly one run. Tossed up, around off, inviting Maxi to go for the sweep. He gets low and does so uppishly, towards the deep square leg region where Trent Boult settles under this one, and takes a very good catch. A nothing shot and Chapman gets his first wicket.
Floated outside off, Wade pushes it towards covers for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Maxwell pushes it through mid off for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Wade flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, Wade pushes it to covers.
The Big Show, Glenn Maxwell strides out into the middle now!
Glenn Maxwell is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ish Sodhi gets the breakthrough and at an important stage too. These two were looking settled until now and this wicket does the Kiwis a world of good. Shorter and outside off, Finch backs away and looks to slam this one through point but does so uppishly. Mitchell Santner is the fielder there, who dives to his left and takes a good catch.
On off, Finch pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Tossed up ball on off, Finch lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short delivery on off, Finch punches it through covers. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it but fails to do so. It races away to the fence.
Tossed up ball on off, Finch defends it off the front foot.
On middle, Wade defends it back towards the bowler.
Full on off, Finch drives it through mid off for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Finch looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on this one. It goes towards the off side.
SIX! That is clobbered! Floated ball on middle, Finch smashes it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Finch is again looking very good as this one was absolutely cracked.
Quicker delivery on middle, Wade flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery down the leg side, Wade looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads.
Full on middle, Finch looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards covers.
Another change in bowling. Glenn Phillips to have a go now!
Short and outside off, Wade punches it through covers for a single. 50-run stand is up between Wade and Finch!
Full on middle, Finch drives it through mid on for a run.
Full on off, Wade drives it through covers for a single.
Short ball on off, Finch pushes it through mid off for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Wade sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Finch keeps it out. A good start for Mark. Only 6 off his first over.
Short delivery on middle, Wade pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Ish Sodhi is introduced into the attack now!
On middle, Wade looks to sweep but gets a top edge. It lands safely towards short third man. The batsmen get a couple.
Short ball on middle, Finch pulls it through mid-wicket for a run. 50 up for Australia!
Floated delivery on middle, Wade sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Finch drives it through covers for a single.
SIX! That is hammered! Full delivery on middle, Wade flicks it over square leg for a maximum. Looked very effortless. 15 runs off this over and Australia are at 47/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Length delivery on middle, Finch flicks it through square leg for a run.
Bowling change. Mark Chapman to roll his arm now.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Finch does not bother to play at that.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery outside off, Finch lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Finch keeps it out.
Short delivery on middle, Wade pulls it through square leg for a run.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Wade leaves it alone.
Full delivery on middle, Finch drives it through mid on for a single.
In the air...safe! Short delivery on middle, Wade looks to pull but gets a top edge and the ball goes over mid-wicket. Lands safe and the batsmen get two runs.
Tim Southee to bowl now. Gave 6 runs off this one.
FOUR! That is caressed! Full on off, Wade drives it through covers for a boundary.
Bouncer on off, Wade does well to duck under it. It goes towards the keeper where Seifert jumps and does well to collect the ball.
Slower delivery outside off, Wade looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on this one.
Length delivery on leg, Finch looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Good length delivery on off, Finch defends it to point.
FOUR! A good shot and a nice way to finish off the over. Tossed up, on middle, Wade sweeps this one through short fine leg, for a boundary. 11 off this over.
Shortish and around off, Wade dabs this one towards short third man, where the fielder fumbles to let them collect two runs.
Short and outside off, AF slaps this one to the left of Tim Southee at point, who does well to put in a dive and stop the ball. A single though.
FOUR! Too full and Finch does not miss out. Flighted around off, Finch makes room and lofts this one over point for a boundary.
A quicker flatter delivery on middle, Finch looks to swivel and pull but he inside edges this one back onto the pad.
Short, around off, kept out by Finch.
Slightly behind the good length and on leg, Finch hops and tucks this one to deep square leg for another single. A good start from Trent. 6 runs and a wicket off his first over.
Short of a length and on the pads, Wade clips this one to square leg and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Wade gets off the mark in style. Boult goes for the full delivery, on the pads, Wade flicks this one nicely towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Short of a good length ball, around off, MW taps this one towards point.
Matthew Wade is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Boult draws first blood and Philippe goes back for a very low score. A very good delivery from Boult and the Kiwis are pumped. A pacy fuller ball on middle and leg, Philippe looks to tuck this one away but the pace is just too much for him to deal with. Gets rapped on the pad and up goes the Black Caps in appeal. The umpire agrees and raises his finger.
Short of a length and around off this time, JP plays this one towards point. A loud no for the single.
Trent Boult is into the attack.
Loopy around off, pushed to point this time. Just the single from this over.
Tossed up, around off, Finch flicks but finds square leg this time.
Darted on the middle pole, AF flicks but finds short fine leg.
Around off, flighted again, Philippe gets down and hoicks this one to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller, flighted, outside off, played to covers again by Josh.
Around off, fuller, pushed to covers.
Mitchell Santner to bowl from the other end.

Leg bye. Another appeal but turned down. On the pads, length, Josh comes down the track and looks to flick but misses. Another appeal for LBW. Another time when the umpire turns it down. No review from Kane Williamson either. The batters sneak a leg bye.
Fuller, on the middle pole, flicked to the deep square leg region for a single.
FOUR! Finch gets off the mark in fine fashion, with a boundary. Southee slides this one on the leg pole, on a length, Finch flicks this one with aplomb through mid-wicket for a boundary.
An appeal for lbw but turned down. Tim goes for the back of a length ball on the pads, Finch looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but this one was going down leg.
Australia and Philippe are underway. On a good length and around off again, Josh pushes this one to the cover region and the batters scamper through for the single.
On a good length and around off this time, Philippe blocks this one out nicely.
We are all set to begin. The New Zealand players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch and Josh Philippe will open the innings for Australia. Tim Southee will start the proceedings for New Zealand.

Adam Zampa is down for an interview. He says that he will look to bowl well today. Adds that his partnership with Ashton Agar has been wonderful. Further says that the T20 World Cup is around the corner and they will look to keep on improving their performance.

PITCH REPORT - Craig McMillan and Rebecca Rolls are the pitch inspectors for the day. Craig says that the sun is out and the conditions look good. Says that spin has played an important part so far in the series. Rebecca chips in and adds that she feels that the deck looks like a belter but whichever team adjusts earlier, then they will prevail. Tells that there will be a lot of turn on offer here too.

Gary Stead, the New Zealand coach is down for an interview. He says that he is excited about the decider. Adds that the team would look to improve from the last game. Mentions that the pitch surprised everyone a bit. Further says that the team is excited for the World Test Championship final and now they know who is their opponent. He credits India for playing so well in the Test series against England.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, Mark Chapman (IN PLACE OF KYLE JAMIESON), James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi, Trent Boult.

Australia (Unchanged Playing XI) - Matthew Wade (WK), Aaron Finch (C), Josh Philippe, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Ashton Agar, Mitchell Marsh, Jhye Richardson, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa, Riley Meredith.

Kane Williamson, New Zealand skipper, says they would have also batted first. Adds that they will look to adjust to the conditions as quickly as possible. Mentions that they are looking for that performance and they will look to improve it today. Informs that Mark Chapman comes in place of Kyle Jamieson.

The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says that they will bat first and says that this is the third time on this wicket and it looks slightly dry as well. Feels that they have kept improving and they want to wrap up the series today nicely. Praises his spinners and has told that they have tried to use them differently. Feels that it always feels nice to contribute to the team. Informs that they are unchanged.
TOSS - Both the captains are out in the middle for the all important toss. The coin lands in the favor of Aaron Finch. AUSTRALIA WILL BAT FIRST!

It is series decider time! After having 4 enthralling T20Is between the Trans-Tasman rivals, we now head into the final T20I of the series between New Zealand and Australia. After dominating the first 2 games, the hosts slightly lost their way and have allowed Australia to come back and now, the series is level at 2-2. Both the teams will be gunning to come out and snatch the win and ultimately, the series. Will the Kiwis be able to bounce back or will the Kangaroos make it 3 wins in 3 and grab the series? All the answers coming up shortly as the toss and the team news are coming up.
